info.name: SaloFresh — Salon Owner Journey
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection covering the complete Salon Owner journey in the SaloFresh API (base path /api/v1). Folders are ordered to match a realistic journey: register/login, onboard a salon, build the service catalog, hire and schedule staff, manage day-to-day bookings, review dashboards, run payroll, manage inventory, run CRM/marketing, handle SaloFresh's own platform subscription billing, and finally review payouts/shift-swaps and support chat.

PREREQUISITES:
- The authenticated user must hold the SALON_OWNER role. This collection's '01 Auth > Register Salon Owner' request registers a brand-new user directly as SALON_OWNER via POST /auth/register/salon-owner (see RegisterSalonOwnerRequest) - there is no separate 'become an owner' upgrade step in this codebase.
- Run 'Login' before anything else; its test script captures accessToken/refreshToken into collection variables consumed by the collection-level Bearer auth.
- Run folders roughly in numeric order the first time through, since later folders depend on ids captured by earlier ones (salonId, serviceId, employeeId, etc.).
- Requests marked 'Destructive - run last' soft-delete a resource that other requests in this collection still reference; run them only once you are done exercising this collection end-to-end.

item.name: 01 Auth

request.description: Register a new Salon Owner account. This is the real mechanism by which a user becomes SALON_OWNER: AuthController#registerSalonOwner assigns the SALON_OWNER role directly (see RegisterSalonOwnerRequest). No separate role-upgrade step is needed. Public endpoint, no role required.

Log in with the salon owner's email/phone and password to obtain an access/refresh token pair. Public endpoint. Captures accessToken and refreshToken from the real LoginResponse fields (data.accessToken / data.refreshToken) into collection variables.

exec: if (json.data.accessToken !== undefined && json.data.accessToken !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', json.data.accessToken); }

request.description: Rotate the refresh token and obtain a new access/refresh token pair. Public endpoint (token itself is the credential). Re-captures both tokens.

exec: if (json.data.accessToken !== undefined && json.data.accessToken !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', json.data.accessToken); }

request.description: Get the currently authenticated salon owner's profile summary, including assigned roles. Requires isAuthenticated() (any logged-in user).

item.description: Registration and login for the Salon Owner. Run Register once, then Login (captures accessToken/refreshToken used by every other request via collection-level bearer auth), then optionally Refresh Token.

request.description: List the weekly working-hours schedule of the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Add a holiday to the salon's calendar. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the new holiday id into holidayId.
List holidays configured for the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Update a holiday entry. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Remove a holiday entry. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Destructive - run after the update example above.

Delete a gallery image. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Destructive - run last.

Upload a compliance document (business license, GST certificate, etc.) for the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role. documentType is a required query param (enum: BUSINESS_LICENSE, GST_CERTIFICATE, IDENTITY_PROOF, ADDRESS_PROOF, OTHER). Multipart file field name is 'file'. Captures the new document id into documentId.
List documents uploaded for the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Delete a previously uploaded document. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Destructive - run last.
List all salons owned by the authenticated salon owner (used for multi-branch owners). Requires SALON_OWNER role.

item.description: Create and configure the salon: profile, working hours, holidays, gallery, compliance documents. Run the lookup requests first to populate cityId, then Create Salon before anything else in this collection.

item.name: 03 Services Catalog

request.description: Public, admin-managed list of fixed service categories; copy an id into categoryId before creating a service. permitAll().
Create a new service offered by the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the new service id into serviceId.

body.raw:
{
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
  "name": "Classic Haircut & Styling",
  "description": "Precision haircut with wash, blow-dry and styling.",
  "durationMinutes": 45,
  "price": 599.0,
  "discountPrice": 499.0,
  "taxPercentage": 18.0,
  "imageUrl": "https://cdn.salofresh.test/services/haircut.jpg",
  "status": "ACTIVE"
}

request.description: List services for the salon. Pass managementView=true (owner only) to include INACTIVE services too. permitAll() at the endpoint level, but managementView is intended for the owning owner.
Get a single service by id. permitAll().
Update an existing service. Requires SALON_OWNER role.

request.description: Toggle a service's ACTIVE/INACTIVE status. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Upload/replace a service's image. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Multipart file field name is 'file'.

Soft-delete the service. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Destructive - run this only after every other folder in this collection that depends on {{serviceId}} (Employees' assign-services, Inventory's service-product-usage) has already been exercised.

item.description: Manage the salon's bookable services (category lookup, create/update/list/detail/status-toggle/image/delete).

item.name: 04 Employees

request.description: Add a new employee (staff member) to the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the new employee id into employeeId.
List employees for the salon (public endpoint, also used during customer booking flows). Filters: status (EmploymentStatus), serviceId.
Get employee detail (public, used during booking).
Update an existing employee. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Assign services offered by the salon to an employee, so customers can book this employee for those services. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Upload or replace an employee's profile photo. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Multipart file field name is 'file'.
Upsert the weekly working schedule of an employee. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the first returned day-schedule id into scheduleId.
Get the weekly schedule of an employee (public, used during booking).
Request leave for an employee. Requires isAuthenticated() - usable by the salon owner on behalf of staff, or by the employee's own account. Captures the new leave request id into leaveId.
List leave requests for an employee. Requires isAuthenticated() - owner or the employee's own account.
Approve or reject an employee's leave request. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Record check-in/check-out attendance for an employee on a given date. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
List attendance records for an employee within a date range. Requires SALON_OWNER role.

Soft-delete an employee. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Destructive - run this only after every other folder in this collection that depends on {{employeeId}} (Payroll, Shift Swaps) has already been exercised.

item.description: Manage salon staff: profiles, service assignment, weekly schedules, leave approval workflow and attendance.

item.name: 05 Bookings Management

request.description: List bookings for the salon, optionally filtered by status/date range. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the first booking's id into bookingId for use by the requests below.
Get a booking by its numeric id or booking number. Requires isAuthenticated(); the underlying service enforces that only the customer or the owning salon owner may view it.
Confirm a pending booking. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Mark a confirmed booking as completed. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Reject a pending booking, with an optional reason. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Use on a different pending booking than the one confirmed/completed above.
Mark a booking as a no-show. Requires SALON_OWNER role.

Refund a payment (full or partial) for a booking. Requires SALON_OWNER, ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role. Set the paymentId collection variable from the payment linked to a completed/cancelled booking (e.g. via GET /payments/my or the booking detail) before running this.
List a salon's visible customer reviews. permitAll(); useful for the owner to find reviews to reply to. Captures the first review's id into reviewId.
Post or edit the salon owner's reply to a customer review. Requires SALON_OWNER role (and ownership of the reviewed salon).
List waitlist demand for the salon (customers waiting for a full slot/employee/date). Requires SALON_OWNER role.

item.description: Day-to-day booking operations for the owner: reviewing, confirming, completing, rejecting and marking no-show; refunds; review replies; waitlist demand.

item.name: 06 Dashboards

request.description: Get the aggregated dashboard summary (revenue, bookings, ratings, etc.) for the authenticated salon owner. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Compare performance metrics across all branches (salons) owned by the authenticated salon owner. Requires SALON_OWNER role.

item.description: Owner-facing analytics: overall dashboard and multi-branch comparison.

item.name: 07 Payroll & Commissions

request.description: Create a commission rule for the salon, optionally scoped to a specific employee and/or service category. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the new rule id into commissionRuleId.
List all commission rules for the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Update an existing commission rule. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Generate a DRAFT payroll record for an employee for a given period, computing commission from completed appointments. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the new payroll record id into payrollId.
List payroll records for the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Finalize a DRAFT payroll record, locking it from further edits. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Mark a FINALIZED payroll record as PAID. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
List payroll records for an employee. Requires SALON_OWNER or EMPLOYEE role - accessible by the employee themselves or the owning salon owner.
Delete a commission rule. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Destructive - run last, after payroll generation above.

item.description: Configure staff commission rules and run the payroll lifecycle: generate, finalize, pay.

item.name: 08 Inventory

request.description: Add a new product to the salon's inventory. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the new product id into productId.
List active products for the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
List products currently at or below their reorder level. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Get a single product. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Update a product. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Record a manual stock movement. type=STOCK_IN with a positive quantity increases stock. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Record a manual stock movement. type=STOCK_OUT with a positive quantity decreases stock (clamped at 0). Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Paginated stock transaction history for a product, most recent first. Requires SALON_OWNER role.

Link a product to a service with a per-service consumption quantity, so stock is auto-tracked as the service is delivered. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the new link id into serviceProductUsageId.
List product usage links configured for a service. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Unlink a product from a service. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Destructive - run last.
Soft-delete a product. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Destructive - run last, after the service-product-usage requests above.

item.description: Product catalog, stock-in/out transactions, low-stock visibility and service-to-product consumption mapping.

item.name: 09 CRM & Marketing

request.description: Add a private CRM note about a customer of this salon (never shown to the customer). Requires SALON_OWNER role. Set customerId to a real customer id (e.g. from a booking's customer) first. Captures the new note id into noteId.
List CRM notes for a customer of this salon, most recent first. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Update a CRM note (original author or salon owner only). Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Get the aggregated CRM profile (customer 360: visit history, spend, notes) for a customer at this salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Soft delete a CRM note (salon owner only). Requires SALON_OWNER role. Destructive - run last.

Create a new marketing campaign for the salon, resolving the target audience into a customer list. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Leave scheduledAt null to dispatch immediately, or set a future instant to schedule it. Captures the new campaign id into campaignId.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Festive Season Offer",
  "message": "Get 20% off on all hair color services this festive season. Book now!",
  "channel": "SMS",
  "targetAudience": "ALL_CUSTOMERS",
  "customCustomerIds": null,
  "scheduledAt": null
}

request.description: List marketing campaigns for the salon. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Get a marketing campaign by id, including recipient counts. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
Send a DRAFT or SCHEDULED campaign immediately. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
List the recipients of a marketing campaign. Requires SALON_OWNER role.

Cancel a DRAFT or SCHEDULED campaign. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Only valid on a campaign that has not already been sent - create a separate campaign to try this if you already ran 'Send Marketing Campaign Now'.

item.description: Private staff-facing customer notes/360 profile, and salon-owner marketing campaign broadcasts.

item.name: 10 Platform Billing

request.description: List the active platform subscription plans available for salon owners to subscribe to. Public endpoint. Captures the first plan's id into planId.

Subscribe to a platform plan. Creates a payment for the selected plan; CASH/WALLET payments are finalized immediately, gateway methods return details needed to confirm. Requires SALON_OWNER role. Captures the resulting payment id into subscriptionPaymentId.
Confirm/capture a platform plan subscription payment and activate the subscription. Requires SALON_OWNER role. gatewayPaymentId/gatewaySignature are ignored for CASH payments.
Get the current owner's active platform subscription, if any. Requires SALON_OWNER role.
List the current owner's platform subscription purchase history. Requires SALON_OWNER role.

item.description: SaloFresh's own subscription billing charged to the salon owner for using the platform (distinct from the salon's customer-facing membership plans in folder 03).

item.name: 11 Payouts & Shift Swaps

request.description: List settlement payouts for the salon. Requires isAuthenticated(); the service layer restricts owners to their own salon (admins can view any salon). Payouts are generated by platform admins (see the separate Admin collection) - this list may be empty until then. Captures the first payout's id into payoutId.
Get a single payout by id (own salon for owners, any salon for admins). Requires isAuthenticated().
Request a shift swap for an employee. Requires isAuthenticated() - usable by the employee's own account OR the salon owner on their behalf. Captures the new request id into shiftSwapId.

item.name: List Shift Swap Requests For Employee

request.description: List shift-swap requests raised by an employee. Requires isAuthenticated() - the employee's own account or the salon owner.

item.name: List Shift Swap Requests For Salon

request.description: List all shift-swap requests for the salon, optionally filtered by status. Requires isAuthenticated(); in practice this salon-wide view is used by the salon owner.

Approve or reject a pending shift-swap request. Requires isAuthenticated(); in practice this decision is made by the salon owner. NOTE: approving does not automatically rewrite the employee's schedule - it is a coordination/visibility tool only.

Cancel a still-pending shift-swap request. Requires isAuthenticated() - the requesting employee's own account or the salon owner. Only valid while still PENDING - do not run after the approve/reject decision above on the same id; use it on a freshly created request instead.

item.description: Read-only visibility into salon settlement payouts, plus the staff shift-swap coordination workflow (owner approves/rejects; either the owner or the employee may create/cancel a request).
